import pandas as pd
import re

file_path = '/data/seva_invoice_register_uncalculated.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Invoice Register', header=3)

# Filter rows where Invoice ID looks like SEVA-##
invoice_mask = df['Invoice ID'].astype(str).str.startswith('SEVA-')
# Also ensure Quantity and Unit Rate are not NaN
df_valid = df[invoice_mask].copy()
print('valid rows', df_valid.shape[0])
print(df_valid[['Invoice ID','Quantity','Unit Rate (INR)','Funding Type']].head(20))

# Convert to numeric
df_valid['Quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df_valid['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
df_valid['Unit Rate (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(df_valid['Unit Rate (INR)'], errors='coerce')
df_valid = df_valid.dropna(subset=['Quantity','Unit Rate (INR)','Funding Type'])

df_valid['Line Amount'] = df_valid['Quantity'] * df_valid['Unit Rate (INR)']
total_spend = df_valid['Line Amount'].sum()
foreign_grant_spend = df_valid.loc[df_valid['Funding Type'] == 'Foreign Grant', 'Line Amount'].sum()
percentage = (foreign_grant_spend / total_spend * 100) if total_spend else 0
print('total', total_spend)
print('foreign', foreign_grant_spend)
print('percentage', percentage)
